svg.title: ADVISOR plots a route from your app to the stack project that answers
svg.desc: A field map of the Wayne State app stack. Three questions are plotted from your app, through the ADVISOR advising office, past numbered control points that are ADVISOR's real tools and prompts, to the project the answer comes from. Route 1: “Which PHP can I build on?” goes through policy_lookup (component: php), and finishes at CREED. Route 2: “Which security headers do I need?” goes through list_stack_rules (chapter: runtime-and-headers), then read_project_docs (project: helmet), and finishes at HELMET. Route 3: “How do I get off PHP 8.2?” goes through the plan_upgrade prompt, then policy_lookup (component: php), then run_proctor_check (checks: php-floor, unbounded-constraints), then read_project_docs (project: booster), and finishes at BOOSTER.

g.text: answer from HELMET: its README and presets
answer from BOOSTER: the upgrade tool,
